name: wp-ai-evals-workspace
description: Development workspace for automattic/wp-ai-evals and the Hello Dolly AI example.

scripts.check: pnpm lint:js && pnpm lint:css && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && composer check
scripts.demo:setup: pnpm build && php scripts/stage-demo-package.php && composer update automattic/wp-ai-evals --working-dir=examples/hello-dolly-ai --no-interaction --no-audit && pnpm --filter hello-dolly-ai-example build
scripts.demo:check: pnpm check && pnpm --filter hello-dolly-ai-example check && pnpm --filter hello-dolly-ai-example test:php
